description: Ministry of Labour - Notify the Industrial Dispute between Discriminated  Employees Union Vs. National Gem & Jewellery : S. Kulabalaselvam Vs. Sri Lanka Transport Boards and Mrs. M. D. Nishanthi Vs. Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment
reasoning: This gazette content primarily consists of orders made under the Industrial Disputes Act, appointing arbitrators to settle specific industrial disputes. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and amendments to this legislation. The content focuses on the legal framework for resolving labor disputes through arbitration, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter.
